cohort: The study included 281 nulliparous participants recruited between May 2019 and February 2022 from a single, high-volume tertiary care center.
finding: In this prospective cohort of nulliparous people, those with trait mindfulness in the 2nd and 3rd quartiles had significantly lower rates of unplanned cesarean delivery compared to those in the 4th quartile.
mod_finding: Participants with trait mindfulness in the 2nd and 3rd quartiles showed significantly lower rates of unplanned cesarean delivery compared to those in the 4th quartile.
